og.title: Laptop Repairs in Nairobi | Zanatechnologies
og.description: Screen, battery, keyboard, hinge, fan and casing repairs using genuine parts. Diagnosis and quote on WhatsApp.

page.heading: Laptop Repairs In Nairobi, Fitted With Genuine Parts
page.intro: Cracked screen, dead battery or a laptop that won't charge? Tell us the model and the problem. We diagnose it, give you a price, and fix it with the same genuine parts we sell across Kenya.

image.alt: A laptop opened up on the repair bench at Zanatechnologies

repairs.heading: What We Repair
repairs.copy: The faults we see most often, and the parts we fit to fix them.

items.label: Screen Replacement
items.desc: Cracked, flickering, lined or blank screen. We fit a genuine replacement panel matched to your model.

items.label: Battery Replacement
items.desc: Laptop dies quickly or won't hold a charge. We replace it with a tested battery that fits your exact model.

items.label: Charging Faults
items.desc: Won't charge or only runs on the cable. We find whether it's the charger, the battery or the charging port.

items.label: Keyboard Replacement
items.desc: Keys not working, sticking or a whole keyboard not responding. We fit a compatible replacement, backlit where the model has one.

items.label: Hinge Repair
items.desc: Screen wobbles, won't stay in position or cracks near the hinge when you open the lid.

items.label: Fan and Overheating Fixes
items.desc: Laptop runs hot, shuts down under load or the fan is loud. We replace worn fans and check for blocked airflow.

items.label: Casing and Palm Rest Replacement
items.desc: Cracked or broken body, palm rest or bottom cover. We fit a replacement casing for your model.

items.label: Not Sure What's Wrong?
items.desc: Send us the symptoms and we'll diagnose the fault, so you know what needs fixing before you commit.

steps.title: Message us on WhatsApp
steps.desc: Send your laptop brand and model, a short description of the problem, and a photo of the fault if you can.

steps.title: We diagnose and quote
steps.desc: We tell you what's wrong and what the repair will cost before any work starts.

steps.title: Drop off your laptop
steps.desc: We confirm where and when to bring it on WhatsApp.

steps.title: We fix it and hand it back
steps.desc: Your laptop is repaired with a genuine part and tested before you collect it.

why.heading: Repairs Backed By Our Own Parts Stock
why.copy: Most repair delays come from waiting on a part. We stock laptop batteries, chargers, screens, keyboards, hinges, fans and casings ourselves, so we can start your repair with the right part instead of sending you off to find one.

image.alt: A replacement laptop part being fitted during a repair

points.label: Genuine parts, tested, not old take-outs
Compatibility checked against your exact model number
The same stock repair shops across Nairobi buy from us

parts.heading: Prefer To Fit It Yourself?
parts.copy: You can buy any of these parts on their own, delivered same day in Nairobi and in 1–2 days to major towns.

faqs.q: How much does a laptop repair cost?
faqs.a: It depends on your laptop model and the part it needs. Send us the model and the problem on WhatsApp and we'll give you a quote.

faqs.q: How long does a repair take?
faqs.a: It depends on the fault and whether the part is in stock. We'll give you an estimate when you message us.

faqs.q: Which laptop brands do you repair?
faqs.a: We stock parts for HP, Dell, Lenovo, Acer, Toshiba, Asus and MacBook. Send us your model and we'll confirm we can help.

faqs.q: I don't know what's wrong with my laptop. Where do I start?
faqs.a: Message us what you're seeing, including any error messages or sounds, and we'll help you work out the fault. The Diagnose the Problem button at the top of this page also opens our symptom guide.

faqs.q: Can I just buy the part and fit it myself?
faqs.a: Yes. Browse the parts in the shop, or send your laptop model on WhatsApp and we'll confirm the right part before you order.

final_cta.heading: Ready To Get Your Laptop Fixed?
final_cta.copy: Message us your laptop model and the problem. We'll take it from there.
